summary.zh-CN: 新增默认关闭的隐私友好型产品活跃统计，并让桌面端内置应用无需系统 Node 也能可靠运行。
summary.en-US: Adds opt-in, privacy-minimized product activity reporting and makes bundled Desktop apps reliable without a system Node installation.

body.zh-CN: 在“隐私与统计”中手动开启最小化的产品活跃数据分享；默认保持关闭。
body.en-US: Enable privacy-minimized product activity sharing from Privacy & Analytics when you choose; it remains off by default.

title.zh-CN: 团队和 QA 流量单独分类

body.zh-CN: 将当前安装标记为外部用户、团队 / 自用或 QA 测试，避免内部设备进入外部用户指标。
body.en-US: Classify an installation as external, team/internal, or QA testing so internal devices stay out of external-user metrics.

title.zh-CN: 桌面端 Service App 不再依赖系统 Node
title.en-US: Desktop Service Apps no longer require system Node

body.zh-CN: 声明 node 或 node.exe 的应用使用 NextClaw 自带 runtime；内置收藏和日历可在未安装系统 Node 的机器上继续读取原有本地数据。
body.en-US: Apps declaring node or node.exe use the runtime bundled with NextClaw. Built-in Favorites and Calendar continue reading existing local data even when system Node is not installed.

body.zh-CN: Service App 启动失败不再把 HTML、裸 500 或内部 endpoint 当作应用内容展示。
body.en-US: Service App startup failures no longer expose HTML, raw 500 responses, or internal endpoints as app content.
